about_the_game:
Vtuber Card Master
A game co-produced by NinthGames, Four Seasons Studio, PTS (Public Television Service), Dream City, and Akutagawa Group.

Vtuber-Themed Card Battle Game

Vtuber Card Master is an innovative card game that blends Vtuber culture with strategic battles. The game seamlessly combines traditional collectible card mechanics with real-time strategy elements, allowing players to build the ultimate Vtuber lineup and engage in tactical showdowns on the battlefield.

Use your strategy and make the most of each Vtuber's unique skills and attributes to claim victory in stages, arenas, and fan duels!

Free to Play – Unlock All Characters

Vtuber Card Master adopts a free-to-play model, where all cards can be obtained without any cost.
Simply launch the game to challenge other players online anytime, anywhere!

Stunning Visuals and Immersive Experience

All card illustrations are crafted by professional artists, bringing each Vtuber's personality and charm to life.
With dynamic skill animations, visual effects, and voice acting, every battle offers a deeply immersive experience—just like watching a thrilling live stream!

About NinthGames

NinthGames is an innovative game studio dedicated to Vtuber content and game development, aiming to create unique experiences that blend both worlds.
Vtuber Card Master is our latest venture, merging Vtuber culture with strategic card battles to deliver an unprecedented competitive experience!
